blurb: The Community Center offers an aquatics park with water slides and a lap pool, fitness classes, childcare, and sports courts. The aquatics park is open seasonally to residents with active memberships and their guests. The Adventure Club provides supervised childcare for children 6 months to 12 years old.
extraNote: Aquatics park closes for 45 minutes to 24 hours after fecal incidents for cleaning · No glass containers or alcoholic beverages allowed in aquatics park · Mandatory 10-minute break every hour in pool use · Membership administration fee $75 for tenants · Aquatics Park seasonal hours May 23-August 2; water park weekends only through Labor Day
